COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
C482 No. 1120 of 2023
With
IA No. 1 of 2023
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Ajay Joshi, Advocate, for the applicants.
Mrs. Mamta Joshi, Brief Holder, for the State
of Uttarakhand.
Ms. Priyanka Agarwal, Advocate, for the
private respondents.
On account of certain minor dispute, which
has taken place, in the function of Rawan Dahan, an
FIR was registered, being FIR No. 317 of 2019
dated 22nd October, 2019, for the alleged
involvement of the named accused persons therein,
for the offences under Sections 147, 323, 504 and
506 of the IPC. After conclusion of the
investigation, chargesheet, being Chargesheet
No. 11 of 2020 dated 24th January, 2020, was
submitted, upon which, the proceedings of Criminal
Case No. 575 of 2022, State Vs. Sube Singh and
others, stood registered before the Court of Judicial
Magistrate, 2nd, Haridwar.
It is in relation to that offence, which has
been referred to in the FIR, and which is subject
matter of Criminal Case No. 575 of 2022, the
present applicants have sought composition of
offence by filing the Compounding Application No.
1 of 2023, in support of the C-482 Application.

The parties, who have participated in the
proceedings through video conferencing, have been
identified by their respective counsels, who owe the
responsibility of their identification.
The learned counsel for the applicants
submitted, that since the offence, for which, the trial
is being carried against the present applicants, some
of the co-accused persons, have approached before
this Court in Writ Petition (Crl.) No. 1531 of
2021, Sube Singh and others Vs. State of
Uttarakhand and others, and the Coordinate
Bench of this Court, based upon the various ratio
laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court, has
compounded the offence by an order dated 23rd
August, 2021. In fact, the present applicants too
claim parity of the composition of the offences,
based upon the judgment of the Coordinate Bench
dated 23rd August, 2021, though in a proceeding
under Article 226 of the Constitution of India.
Since it is not in controversy, that the present
applicants too are subjected to criminal trial by
Criminal Case No. 575 of 2022, State Vs. Sube
Singh and others, the present C-482 Application,
would stand disposed of in terms of the
Compounding Application, which has been duly
signed by the respective parties to the C-482
Application, and their counsels, who have verified
the contents of the Compounding Application.
This C-482 Application would stand
disposed of in terms of the Compounding

Application, as well as in terms of the statement
made by the counsel for the parties representing
them, and as a consequence thereto, the proceedings
of Criminal Case No. 575 of 2022, State Vs. Sube
Singh and others, pending consideration before the
Court of Judicial Magistrate, 2nd, Haridwar, would
hereby stand quashed.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 12.06.2023
Shiv
